mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, the weather is clear near the Military Ridge State Trail and we are under a new moon.
The Verona Common Council recently passed the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, while the city also continues to receive high marks for its financial health with a Moody's Aa1 rating.
We have a busy weekend ahead, starting with Live Music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
In a notable incident on September 28, a 16-year-old was cited for reckless driving after an eMoto collision near Enterprise Drive.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Cashew, so make sure to stop by when they open today at 10:00 AM.
